contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTAN[TIVS P]F AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Constantius II (323-361) , Trier mint two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Possibly RIC Volume 8 no. 207. Obverse description: Youthful bust diademed draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN[TIVS P]F AVG. Reverse description: two Victories facing each other and holding up wreaths. A star below wreaths. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN. In exergue: TRP . Diameter: 16.4mm, Weight: 0.86gms, die axis: 12
